name: Frequency Domain Volume Rendering
aliases: Frequency Domain Volume Rendering (FVR) on GPU
definition: A rendering pipeline where the dataset is pre-processed on CPU, uploaded to GPU, and rendered via slicing and inverse transform stages.
summary: Frequency Domain Volume Rendering transforms data to the frequency domain to decouple rendering performance from dataset resolution, relying on the Projection-Slice Theorem to avoid the high computational cost of spatial methods.
